# RUN-M1-2 — plan (UI-SCAF-01, UI-CLIENT-01)

Interfaces and rules; bodies only where the content is configuration that must be exact. Decisions D1–D11 are in `spec.md`. Tiers per `context/test-environment.md`.

## Interfaces

```ts
// @/ → frontend/src/ (vite resolve.alias + tsconfig paths, no baseUrl)
// src/shared/api/schema.gen.ts — generated by openapi-typescript: exports `paths`, `components`, `operations`
// src/shared/storage/safeStorage.ts
export const safeStorage: { get(key: string): string | null; set(key: string, value: string): void; remove(key: string): void };
// src/shared/ui/cx.ts
export function cx(...classes: (string | false | null | undefined)[]): string;
// src/vite-env.d.ts
interface ImportMetaEnv { readonly VITE_API_BASE_URL?: string }
// src/shared/api/types.ts
export type OperationName = components['schemas']['OperationName'];
export type CalculationResult = components['schemas']['CalculationResult'];
export type Problem = components['schemas']['Problem'];
export type ProblemCode = components['schemas']['ProblemCode'];
export type ApiError =
  | { kind: 'problem'; status: number; code: ProblemCode; title: string; detail?: string; requestId?: string }
  | { kind: 'network' } | { kind: 'timeout' } | { kind: 'aborted' }
  | { kind: 'unexpected'; status?: number };
export type ApiResult<T> = { ok: true; data: T } | { ok: false; error: ApiError };
export interface CalculatorApi {
  calculate(operation: OperationName, operands: readonly string[], options?: { signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<ApiResult<CalculationResult>>;
}
// src/shared/api/problem.ts
export const PROBLEM_CODES: readonly ProblemCode[]; // the 13 contract codes, contract order
export function isProblem(value: unknown): value is Problem;
// src/shared/api/calculatorApi.ts
export const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 8000;
export interface CalculatorApiOptions { baseUrl: string; timeoutMs?: number; fetch?: (request: Request) => Promise<Response> }
export function createCalculatorApi(options: CalculatorApiOptions): CalculatorApi;
export function resolveBaseUrl(configured: string | undefined, origin: string): string;
// src/shared/api/apiContext.ts, CalculatorApiProvider.tsx
export const CalculatorApiContext: React.Context<CalculatorApi | null>;
export function useCalculatorApi(): CalculatorApi;
export function CalculatorApiProvider(props: { api: CalculatorApi; children: ReactNode }): JSX.Element;
// src/shared/api/index.ts re-exports types, PROBLEM_CODES, isProblem, createCalculatorApi, resolveBaseUrl, DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS, CalculatorApiOptions, useCalculatorApi, CalculatorApiProvider
```

## Rules (prose)

R1 `theme-init.js` (ES5 classic script): reads `localStorage['calculator.theme.v1']` in try/catch; exactly `light` or `dark` → `data-theme` on `<html>`; anything else (missing, `system`, junk, a thrown access) → no attribute written.
R2 `index.html`: `lang="en"`, charset, viewport `width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover`, description, `color-scheme` `light dark`, SVG favicon, `<script src="/theme-init.js">` in `<head>` (blocking), title `Calculator`, `#root`, module script `/src/main.tsx`. No inline script, style element or style attribute.
R3 `tokens.css`: three blocks (`:root`; `:root[data-theme='dark']`; `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root:not([data-theme='light']) }`); 23 colour tokens = DESIGN.md frontmatter colour keys (light on `:root`, `-dark` values in both dark blocks, identical); plus fonts, spacing 1/2/3/4/6/8, radius sm/md/lg, `--key-size: 3.5rem`, `--transition-fast: 120ms ease-out`, `--shadow-card` light and dark.
R4 `global.css`: imports tokens; box-sizing; `color-scheme` per theme; body background/text/font; `:focus-visible` 3px solid `--color-focus`, offset 2px; `.visually-hidden`; reduced-motion block.
R5 favicon: 32×32 `viewBox`, rounded square `#2f5fd0`, white `=` of two rects, < 400 bytes.
R6 `safeStorage`: never throws; `get` returns `null` on a thrown access.
R7 `cx`: joins truthy strings with one space.
R8 Vite: `VITE_PORT` unset → 5173; set → must be an integer 1–65535 (else the config throws `VITE_PORT must be an integer from 1 to 65535`); `strictPort: true`; proxy `/api` → `API_PROXY_TARGET ?? 'http://localhost:8081'`.
R9 `isProblem(v)`: `v` is a non-null object, not an array; `type`, `title`, `detail`, `requestId` strings; `status` an integer within 400–599; `code` a string in `PROBLEM_CODES`; `instance` absent or a string; `errors` absent or an array whose every item is a non-null object with string `field` and `reason`.
R10 `calculate`: POST `/api/v1/operations/{operation}` with `{ operands: [...operands] }`, `Content-Type: application/json`, signal `AbortSignal.any([caller, AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs)])` (timeout only when no caller signal). Outcomes: response received and `response.ok` and body is a `CalculationResult` whose `operation` equals the requested one (`operands` array of strings, `result` string, `inexact` boolean) → `ok`; 2xx otherwise (empty, 204, wrong shape, other operation) → `unexpected(status)`; non-2xx and `isProblem(body)` and `body.status === status` → `problem` with `status/code/title/detail/requestId`; non-2xx otherwise (text, HTML, JSON not a problem, status mismatch) → `unexpected(status)`. Thrown: combined signal aborted → its `reason` identifies the first source: the timeout signal's reason → `timeout`, else `aborted`; not aborted, a response was received and the error is an `Error` named `SyntaxError` → `unexpected(status)`; anything else (including non-`Error` rejections and synchronous throws of the configured fetch) → `network`. Never rejects.
R10b `resolveBaseUrl(configured, origin)`: non-empty `configured` → `configured`; `undefined` or `''` → `origin`.
R11 `useCalculatorApi` outside `CalculatorApiProvider` throws `useCalculatorApi must be used inside <CalculatorApiProvider>`; inside returns the provided instance (reference-equal).
R12 Contract stage: selected by `ci_is_contract` (`backend/api/openapi.yaml`, `redocly.yaml`; unchanged, these also select the backend stage) or by the new `ci_is_contract_input` (`frontend/package.json`, `frontend/pnpm-lock.yaml`, `frontend/.prettierrc.json`, `frontend/src/shared/api/schema.gen.ts`; contract stage only); `--full` treats the stage as present when either predicate matches a tracked or untracked file. Needs pnpm and `frontend/node_modules` (missing → `ci_problem contract 'run pnpm -C frontend install --frozen-lockfile'`); runs `contract:redocly` (`pnpm -C frontend run lint:api`) and `contract:types` (`bash -c 'set -o pipefail; …'`: `openapi-typescript ../backend/api/openapi.yaml` to stdout → `prettier --stdin-filepath src/shared/api/schema.gen.ts` → `diff -u src/shared/api/schema.gen.ts -`, from `frontend/`).
R13 Frontend stage, targeted: typecheck always. A global input touched (`frontend/` + `package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `vite.config.ts`, `tsconfig*.json`, `eslint.config.js`, `.prettierrc.json`, `.prettierignore`, `src/test/**`) → `lint`, `format:check`, `test` scripts (whole package). Else ESLint `--max-warnings=0 --no-warn-ignored` on touched JS/TS, Prettier `--check --ignore-unknown` on touched files, and `vitest related --run --no-passWithNoTests <touched .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx>`: exit 0 → pass; exit 1 with the output containing `No test files found, exiting with code 1` and no `FAIL` → note `frontend:vitest no related tests`; anything else → fail. Full: typecheck, lint, format:check, test, build.
